fact: Biometric Update reports a biometric voter-registration exercise began on 1 February 2025, expected to enrol nearly 3 million holders of the ECOWAS biometric ID card absent from the electoral database, running to 31 July 2025.

fact: Biometric Update says the 2025 biometric registration drive adds to the 7.3 million voters already held in Senegal's electoral database.
